symptom: A Starlark rule could not see a microflow's sequence flows (which log belongs to which custom error handler, which activity an annotation is attached to, which split branch is true) nor where an object sits on the canvas: flows_for() was undefined and activities had no x/y.
cause: The reader decodes ObjectCollection.Flows and AnnotationFlows and each object's RelativeMiddlePoint and Size (describe prints them as on error, @annotation and @position), but the catalog builder walked Objects only.
insight: Measure where the flows live before walking: on 11.12 every flow, loop bodies' included, is on the document's top-level Flows (bson dump --format ndsl), but an object's RelativeMiddlePoint inside a loop is relative to the loop's box, so x/y compare only within one parent_loop_id. A boolean split's branch reads back as an EnumerationCase with Value 'true'/'false', not a BooleanCase. On the Studio Pro-authored TestApp all 1476 flow ends resolve to an activities Id.
